title: Exploring Trauma Plus (ET+)
official: Exploring Trauma Plus (ET+): A Brief Intervention for Men and Gender-Diverse Populations
summary:
This randomized controlled trial evaluates Exploring Trauma Plus (ET+), a brief, manualized, trauma-specific intervention designed for justice-involved men and transgender and gender-diverse individuals. The six-session curriculum uses psychoeducation, cognitive-behavioral strategies, mindfulness, grounding techniques, and structured exercises to help participants understand trauma, manage trauma-related distress, and develop coping skills.

The study is beging conducted at a California correctional facility for men and compares participants randomly assigned to ET+ with participants assigned to a waitlist control condition. The program is delivered by trained peer facilitators in general institutional housing on a custody level III yard.

Researchers assess changes in trauma-related distress, behavioral health symptoms, anger, and aggression using validated self-report measures administered before and after the intervention period.

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: All participants who expressed interest in participating in the study at the California men's prison and who were capable of providing written informed consent.

\-

Exclusion Criteria: There were no study-defined exclusion criteria; operational exclusions or security restrictions were at the discretion of prison administration.
